I was reminded that I had forgotten a question.

If a Player 'A' plays a Master Discipline card on Player 'B's minion and a
Dauntain Black Magician owned by Player 'C' attempts to steal the Master
Discipline card, who can attempt the block? Player 'A' because it is still
controlled by him/her? Player 'B' because action is to remove a capability
from his/her minion?

This question has me searching for the answer in circles due to the
Master/Minion card differences and the control issue.

Michael Eichler
Prince of Ramstein

Player A. The Master/Minion issue should be easy to resolve here, since
the card is clearly a master card. The control issue has been covered, and
the "direction" is handled in:

Section 6.2.2.1: "If an action targets ... something controlled by another
Methuselah ... then the Methuselah who ... controls the target may ... block
the action."
